svg.aria-label: Plot layout decision: user choices are kept, bins gives a histogram, the plot kind follows from the dimensions left, empty axes and facets take the free dimensions, then col_wrap and figure size get defaults.

g.title: sel
g.text: select data only: they never change the mode

g.title: pins
g.text: _user_pins(): x, y, hue, col, row (that order)
kept if on the variable and not used by an earlier role,

g.title: hist_user
g.text: x / y / hue / facets: note “not used”

g.title: fix
g.text: hue with x and y → y dropped
hue with no other dimension → hue dropped

g.title: draw
g.text: · pcolormesh (coordinate axes); single map → equal axes

g.title: line_hue
g.text: unless x or y is set

g.title: image
g.text: x = last free dimension, y = the one before

g.title: hist_none
g.text: (single value, or nothing left inside a panel)

g.title: many
g.text: “slice one of them to an index”

g.title: wrap
g.text: _figure_size(): facets 4 in high, aspect 1 unless set;
a single plot keeps yours (size added for aspect)

g.title: dt
g.text: 1D line, x automatic, datetime variable selected

g.title: out
g.text: kind · choices (role, value, user | auto) · squeezed · notes
